chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
There is no good in one who does not desire to gather wealth from halal means, so that by it he may protect his dignity, pay his debt, and maintain his kinship ties.

key_terms.رَحِمَهُ: his kinship ties or blood relations

ai.seo_question: Why does the Imam, peace be upon him, praise earning halal wealth?
ai.summary: The Imam, peace be upon him, teaches that seeking wealth through halal means is praiseworthy when it serves worthy purposes. Such wealth enables a person to preserve dignity, fulfill financial obligations, and uphold ties of kinship.
